root_idea.summary: The root centers on lowering or putting something down into a position.
root_idea.development: From this core, the lexicon develops meanings of placing and establishing, bringing forth, presenting something for inspection, and figurative lowering; derived forms also extend to humility, rapid movement, and related specialized uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Form I verb has several independently supported Quranic constructions.
The Form IV verb has a distinct Quran-attested movement meaning.
Presented under its singular dictionary citation form مَوْضِعٌ.
Presented under the singular masculine passive-participial citation form مَوْضُوعٌ.

senses.definition: To put, lay, set, or establish something in a place or position.
senses.usage_conditions: Covers physical placement and setting something aside, as well as establishing the House, the earth, or the balance; in such creation or establishment contexts, the wording can convey bringing something into being.

senses.definition: To bring forth or give birth.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the childbirth construction for delivering a child.

senses.definition: To bring a record or written account forward for presentation, making its contents visible for inspection.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use of placing the record refers to the presentation of people's recorded deeds, not merely to putting an object down.

senses.definition: To lower or remove a burden and thereby relieve someone of it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the lowering or removal of burdens; this is a resultative use distinct from simply placing an object in a location.

senses.definition: To hasten or move rapidly, especially to urge a mount onward.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction describes rapid movement through or among people; the derived verb can also be used of making an animal move quickly.

senses.definition: A place or position; figuratively, the proper context, application, or meaning of words.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural مَوَاضِع occurs in the expression concerning words being turned away from their proper places or contexts.
The Quranic occurrence is the feminine passive participle modifying cups that have been set out or placed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appoint or provide a sign, token, or indication for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with لَهُ for assigning a sign or token to or for a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impose a fine, tax, or similar charge upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object of the imposition is marked with عَلَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remit a tax or similar charge, declining to exact it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the opposite result from imposing a charge and is a distinct conventional use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relinquish war and make peace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic, explicitly tropical expression in which war is treated as something laid down; it contrasts with raising war.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower someone's grade, rank, condition, or estimation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْهُ or عَنْهُ for lowering status or standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffer loss or diminution in trade and fail to gain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction refers specifically to loss in commercial activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To forge a word or a piece of poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may involve fabricating speech or poetry in someone's name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assign or appropriate a word or phrase to denote a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A terminological use concerning the establishment of a designation for an object or concept.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or set a thing according to someone's or something's measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed or appositional construction concerning conformity to a specified measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become lowly, humble, submissive, or abased; to humble oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the reciprocal Form VI development of lowering applied to one's own status or demeanor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For two parties to lay bets, wagers, or stakes against one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A mutual construction equivalent to wagering with each other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For land to lie lower than the land next to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly tropical use describing relative elevation of terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Collocation, posture, or positional arrangement, including a position among the philosophical categories.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical nominal use referring to the way things are positioned or combined.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The constitution, conformation, make, mode, or manner of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes how something is constituted or arranged, including its general manner or mode.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bringing forth or giving birth, as a verbal noun associated with وَضَعَتْ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal form referring to the act of delivery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, ignoble, vile, mean, or of little rank or estimation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use describing low social or evaluative standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depository or trusted repository for a secret.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression for a person who is the place or repository of another's secret.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The grammatical position in which a word has the nominative function or case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical expression equivalent to saying that its position is one of رفع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ground or basis for something, or the proper object of an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a ground for belief, trust, or accusation and a person or thing properly deserving an action such as honoring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular easy or lowered pace of a beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized movement term contrasted with a raised or elevated gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In logic, the subject as opposed to the predicate, and a substance as opposed to an accident.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical logical use, explicitly marked as tropical and contrasted with مَحْمُولٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The subject or topic of a book or similar work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly tropical extension from what is set out as the topic under discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A convention or established terminology in lexicology.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a technical term equivalent to اصطلاح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low-lying, as of a hill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly assumed tropical description in the cited phrase for a low hill.
